en.prefs.security_note: Signing and checking the designs you save. Off by default.
en.prefs.security.sign_saved_help: Each save adds a signature from your GnuPG key. A key on a YubiKey stays on the smartcard; GnuPG asks for its PIN.
en.prefs.security.signing_key_help: A key fingerprint or user id. Empty uses GnuPG's default signing key.
en.prefs.security.verify_opened_help: Reads every payload to check the signature. Off: a signed design opens without that extra read, and File > Verify Signature checks it on request.
en.prefs.security.encryption_note: Encrypting design files with GnuPG is the next part of this work: encrypted designs and an encrypted indicator arrive together.
en.ui.open_signature_not_covered: Signed earlier, then saved without a key
en.ui.open_signature_unsupported: This signature needs a newer SolidCraft
en.ui.open_signature_unverified: Signed; not checked in this session
en.prefs.security.encrypt_saved_help: Each save is encrypted with GnuPG, so only the chosen recipients can read it. A YubiKey smartcard decrypts it on open and asks for its PIN. Desktop only.
en.prefs.security.encryption_recipients_hin: Empty: your own GnuPG default key
en.prefs.security.encryption_recipients_hel: GnuPG key ids, fingerprints or user ids, separated by commas. Empty encrypts to your own GnuPG default key, so your YubiKey decrypts it.
